verified_title: Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model
problem: VLM understanding and video dynamics priors are usually isolated, while heterogeneous videos lack compatible robot action labels.
contribution: An8B mixture-of-transformers joins video, understanding and action experts; independently noised video/actions enable five inference distributions. A flow-derived14D latent action provides weakly supervised motion pretraining across human/robot data.
algorithm: Wan2.2-5B video expert,Qwen3-VL-2B understanding expert and separate action/understanding adapters share joint attention. Train independent-time rectified-flow objectives. DPFlow optical flow is reconstructed by aDC-AE; four512D tokens project to14D latent action, with90% unlabeled and10% real-action-supervised data, alignment+KL losses. Stages train video dynamics, latent-action experts, then target controls. Dense actions/sparsevideo use6:1 temporal sampling.
observations: Language, present RGB and platform-dependent proprioception; action chunks48@30Hz andvideo8@5Hz in general config. RoboTwin uses16-step chunks. IDM mode explicitly observes future frames, unlike the current-observation-only regression baselines described in its appendix.
actions: Robot-specific continuous controls after target-robot fine-tuning.14D latent action dimensionality is a learned representation, not guaranteed physical joint semantics or a universal actuator interface. Mode choice determines whether actions,video or both are sampled/conditioned.
embodiment_and_data: RoboTwin27500 trajectories,230949EgoDex,728209Agibot plus RDT/RoboMind,1000task-agnostic examples and2000in-house target examples. Real tasks use100training trajectories/task on AC-One andAgilex-Aloha-2. Pretraining/fine-tuning budgets roughly8000+10000+400GPUh (GPU model not extracted).
experiments: Fifty-task RoboTwin clean/randomized joint training,40kfine-tuning steps and100evaluations/task. Hardware scores grant subgoal credit; detailed tables give actual counts: towel20trials/platform,fourperfive towel types; several other tasks10 or20trials. Additional modes are tested with reconstruction/MSE metrics and VLA versusjoint policy success.
baselines: pi0.5,X-VLA,from-scratch andvideo-stage-only variants. Real comparison is mostlypi0.5. IDM baselines ResNet18/DINOv2+MLP are described as taking current observation only, so their MSE comparison confounds the future information available to Motus IDM.

quantitative_result.simulation: PDF p7 Table2:88.66%clean/87.02%randomized versusX-VLA72.80/72.84 andpi0.5 42.98/43.84,100trials/task. Figure6's from-scratch clean77.56 disagrees withTable2's72.8; do not use that ablation effect as reconciled.
quantitative_result.physical: PDF p8 Table3 averages partial scores63.22%AC-One/59.30%Agilex versus14.79/48.60pi0.5. Critically p19 Tables15–16 show Motus COMPLETE towel-fold success0/20 on BOTH platforms despite partial scores14.5% and39%; pi0.5 completes1/20 onAgilex. AC-One cube placement20/20 is a different rigid-object task.
quantitative_result.modes: PDF p14 Table8:randomized VLA83.90% versusjoint87.02%. Table7 IDM MSE0.014 on100samples versus0.044/0.122, with unequal described observability. These are not physical control successes.

limitations: Aggregate partial scores conceal zero complete towel folds. Gains are not universal: Agilex oven34versuspi0.5 36 andkeyboard80versusscratch85. Flow compression can retain camera/background motion;14D matching does not by itself prove embodied action alignment. Heavy expert stack and extensive pretraining are not edge-ready evidence. Some claims of all-task improvement and clean ablation numbers conflict with tables.
code_and_license: No pinned source, weights or license audit and no execution. Foundation-model/data citations do not grant derivative reuse; terms UNKNOWN.
hardware_adaptation: COMPARE offline latent-flow auxiliary supervision and independent-noise mode selection.8B FP16 weights alone approach16GB before encoders/VAE/caches, so NX feasibility is unproven. Use calibrated measured SO101/M3 state/action schemas rather than treating14D latents as motor commands. Paper's own complete-fold0/20 means it cannot substantiate a ready cloth/sock manipulation skill.
